Read the status of jira ticket {{JIRA_TICKET}}. It is not allowed to read or write files out of the current folder. If you need to write, use current tmp subfolder which is in .gitignore file. If all current OpenSpec changes were archived, you MUST create a new PR and move jira ticket to "IN REVIEW" status. Otherwise, current branch MUST be pushed and move jira ticket to "DEVELOPMENT FAILED".
